definitions: The unwritten rules and social norms governing appropriate behavior and communication within a bullet screen (danmaku) viewing environment.
Guidelines for respectful and effective interaction when using or viewing real-time, overlaid comments on a video or live stream.
examples: Good bullet screen etiquette dictates not spamming the chat.
Understanding bullet screen etiquette enhances the viewing experience for everyone.
New users often need to learn bullet screen etiquette.
